td.lat IS NOT NULL AND td.lng IS NOT NULL AND ST_DWithin(goroute_point(td.lat, td.lng), goroute_point(#{criteria.latitude}, #{criteria.longitude}), #{criteria.radiusMeters}, false)

tr.destination_lat IS NOT NULL AND tr.destination_lng IS NOT NULL AND ST_DWithin(goroute_point(tr.destination_lat, tr.destination_lng), goroute_point(#{criteria.latitude}, #{criteria.longitude}), #{criteria.radiusMeters}, false) AND NOT COALESCE(( SELECT bool_and(x.lat IS NOT NULL AND x.lng IS NOT NULL) FROM trip_destinations x WHERE x.trip_id = tr.id), FALSE)
mapper.select:
SELECT t.id, t.owner_id FROM trips t
JOIN ( SELECT near.trip_id, MIN(near.distance_m) AS distance_m FROM ( SELECT td.trip_id, ST_Distance(goroute_point(td.lat, td.lng), goroute_point(#{criteria.latitude}, #{criteria.longitude}), false) AS distance_m FROM trip_destinations td WHERE UNION ALL SELECT tr.id AS trip_id, ST_Distance(goroute_point(tr.destination_lat, tr.destination_lng), goroute_point(#{criteria.latitude}, #{criteria.longitude}), false) AS distance_m FROM trips tr WHERE ) near GROUP BY near.trip_id ) nearest ON nearest.trip_id = t.id
JOIN ( SELECT td.trip_id FROM trip_destinations td WHERE UNION SELECT tr.id AS trip_id FROM trips tr WHERE ) nearby ON nearby.trip_id = t.id
WHERE t.visibility = 'PUBLIC' AND t.is_deleted = FALSE AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM content_takedowns ct WHERE ct.content_type = 'TRIP' AND ct.content_id = t.id AND ct.restored_at IS NULL)
AND t.owner_id != #{excludeUserId,javaType=java.util.UUID,jdbcType=OTHER} AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM trip_members tm WHERE tm.trip_id = t.id AND tm.user_id = #{excludeUserId,javaType=java.util.UUID,jdbcType=OTHER} AND tm.status = 'ACCEPTED')
AND ( LOWER(t.destination) LIKE LOWER(CONCAT('%', #{criteria.destination}, '%')) OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM trip_destinations x WHERE x.trip_id = t.id AND (LOWER(x.name) LIKE LOWER(CONCAT('%', #{criteria.destination}, '%')) OR LOWER(x.address) LIKE LOWER(CONCAT('%', #{criteria.destination}, '%')))) )
AND ( LOWER(t.name) LIKE LOWER(CONCAT('%', #{criteria.keyword}, '%')) OR LOWER(t.destination) LIKE LOWER(CONCAT('%', #{criteria.keyword}, '%')) OR LOWER(t.description) LIKE LOWER(CONCAT('%', #{criteria.keyword}, '%')) OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM trip_destinations x WHERE x.trip_id = t.id AND (LOWER(x.name) LIKE LOWER(CONCAT('%', #{criteria.keyword}, '%')) OR LOWER(x.address) LIKE LOWER(CONCAT('%', #{criteria.keyword}, '%')))) )
ORDER BY
(NULLIF(TRIM(COALESCE(t.cover_image_url, '')), '') IS NOT NULL OR t.memory_count > 0) DESC,
( LEAST(t.activity_count, 12) * 3 + LEAST(t.memory_count, 10) * 2 + GREATEST(0, 45 - EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (NOW() - COALESCE(t.public_shared_at, t.created_at))) / 86400) ) DESC, COALESCE(t.public_shared_at, t.created_at) DESC, t.id
MD5(t.id::text || #{criteria.randomSeed}), t.id
COALESCE(t.public_shared_at, t.created_at) DESC, t.id DESC
nearest.distance_m ASC, COALESCE(t.public_shared_at, t.created_at) DESC, t.id
LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT t.id FROM trips t WHERE t.id IN ( SELECT a.trip_id FROM activities a WHERE a.place_ref_id = #{placeId,javaType=java.util.UUID,jdbcType=OTHER} AND COALESCE(a.status, '') <> 'REJECTED' UNION SELECT a.trip_id FROM places p JOIN activities a ON a.place_id = p.place_id AND a.place_ref_id IS NULL WHERE p.id = #{placeId,javaType=java.util.UUID,jdbcType=OTHER} AND COALESCE(a.status, '') <> 'REJECTED' UNION SELECT a.trip_id FROM activities a WHERE a.place_ref_id IS NULL AND a.place_id = CAST(#{placeId,javaType=java.util.UUID,jdbcType=OTHER} AS TEXT) AND COALESCE(a.status, '') <> 'REJECTED') AND t.visibility = 'PUBLIC' AND t.is_deleted = FALSE AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM content_takedowns ct WHERE ct.content_type = 'TRIP' AND ct.content_id = t.id AND ct.restored_at IS NULL) ORDER BY COALESCE(t.public_shared_at, t.created_at) DESC, t.id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

UNION ALL
SELECT t.*, tm.joined_at as sort_date FROM trips t INNER JOIN trip_members tm ON t.id = tm.trip_id WHERE tm.user_id = #{userId,javaType=java.util.UUID,jdbcType=OTHER} AND tm.status = 'ACCEPTED' AND t.is_deleted = FALSE AND t.owner_id != #{userId,javaType=java.util.UUID,jdbcType=OTHER} ) SELECT id, name, cover_image_url, destination, destination_place_id, destination_lat, destination_lng, start_date, end_date, budget, currency, status, visibility, share_code, share_expenses, share_notes, description, timezone, owner_id, starting_point_name, starting_point_address, starting_point_lat, starting_point_lng, starting_point_time, view_count, copy_count, helpful_votes, unhelpful_votes, is_deleted, deleted_at, public_shared_at, created_at, updated_at FROM user_trips ORDER BY sort_date DESC LIMIT 1
